text: #881's plan, P-0881, pinned a test whose fixture could never run. For a wrong start one size larger, the fixture wrote the other start as a lambda in the driver, and the collector refuses an initializer that isn't the staged application's own code (D-0183, D-0451). So the test stopped before the larger check, on main and on any build, and the factory's build, #915, stopped there. On 2026-11-13 @gitdek approved changing that pinned test by hand in place of a redraft and a rebuild: the other start is now a function of the staged application that the driver names, and what the test asserts is unchanged. With it the test fails on main for the plan's reason and passes on the build. #918 finishes the build by hand, and #915 closes without merging.
